videos.overview: Gautam's goon traps Anupama and Hasmukh in a café after cutting the gas pipe. Digvijay arrives just in time to rescue them from the leaking gas.

videos.title: Vasundhara's Stern Warning
videos.overview: Vasundhara warns Gautam not to scheme against the Shah family using her name. Anupama is overwhelmed after seeing the café titled 'Anu Ki Rasoi'.

videos.title: Shruti's Surprise for Prem and Rahi
videos.overview: Anupama performs a café puja. Shruti surprises Prem and Rahi with the opening of their dream café on Mother's Day—right opposite Anupama's, leaving her shocked.

videos.title: Rahi Turns against Anupama
videos.overview: Rahi stands against Anupama, leaving her heartbroken over Rahi's hatred towards her. Digvijay and the others celebrate the cafe's successful first-day profit.

videos.title: Digvijay Defends Banku
videos.overview: Prem aims for business success with Vasundhara's support. Digvijay stands up for Banku when Paritosh and Pakhi attempt to humiliate him.

videos.title: Anupama Saves Prem
videos.overview: During Vat Savitri Puja, Rahi grows worried as an obstacle disrupts her ritual. Anupama bravely saves Prem from live electric wires, and Prem invites her to his cafe opening.

videos.title: Prem Insults Anupama
videos.overview: Rahi and Anupama face media questions about their rival cafes. Anupama blesses Prem for his new start, but driven by hatred, he insults and hurts her.

videos.title: Digvijay Learns Anupama's Story
videos.overview: Digvijay confronts Prem for insulting Anupama. Later, Hasmukh shares Anupama's life struggles with him, leaving Digvijay shocked by her patience and greatness.

videos.title: Anupama's Empowering Decision
videos.overview: Anupama opens up to Digvijay about her painful past and the challenges she has overcome. She vows to buy her own house, with Digvijay supporting her decision.

videos.title: Digvijay's Business Proposal
videos.overview: Prerana confronts Shruti for blaming her for exposing their business to Anupama. Digvijay proposes a business deal with Prem to encourage compromise and co-existence.

videos.title: A Big Order for Anupama, Digvijay
videos.overview: Anupama fills out a competition form, while Prem also joins the contest. Impressed by Anupama's tasty food, Digvijay's friend books lunch for thirty members at his cafe.

videos.title: Prerana Gets Blamed
videos.overview: Shruti confronts Anupama for stealing her customers and blames Prerana for the loss. Due to Prem's lack of trust, Prerana breaks her friendship with him and quits his cafe.

videos.title: Anupama Fumes at Prem
videos.overview: Prem vows to ruin Anupama and defeat her in the cafe business. Furious over his actions, Anupama reveals to Prem that Prerana attempted suicide.

videos.title: Prerana Gets a New Opportunity
videos.overview: Digvijay cheers up Prerana and offers her a chance to work at his cafe. Meanwhile, Pari finds comfort and strength in Anupama and Kinjal's support for her fear of pregnancy.

videos.title: Shruti Plots against Anupama's Cafe
videos.overview: Pari's pregnancy is celebrated with dance at the cafe, but she misses Rahi's presence. Shruti plots against Anupama by buying out her suppliers and pulling customers towards their cafe.

videos.title: Paras's Shocking Revelations
videos.overview: Paras shocks Digvijay by revealing that Gautam and Vasundhara met Ranvijay. Meeta taunts Rahi for not planning a baby, but Khyati defends her.

videos.title: Prem Faces Digvijay's Wrath
videos.overview: Digvijay fumes at Prem for his humiliation and decides not to forgive him. Anupama interrupts Digvijay from explaining his reason for slapping Prem.

videos.title: Prem Turns Against Anupama
videos.overview: Anupama learns from Hasmukh that Digvijay was right and realizes her mistake. Prem urges Vasundhara not to respect Anupama and decides to seek revenge on her.

videos.title: Anupama's Appeal to Digvijay
videos.overview: Anupama apologises to Digvijay for Prem's misconduct and urges him to stay. Prem faces criticism from Khyati and Anil, sparking heated arguments in the Kothari family.

videos.title: Prerana Faces Prem's Anger
videos.overview: Anupama and Digvijay unveil their bold plan to serve healthy, fusion food to today's kids. Prem confronts Prerana over her shocking business betrayal.

videos.title: Prem Humiliates Anupama
videos.overview: Anupama prepares food for her first order, but Prem shocks her by snatching the same order through his connections. After insulting Anupama, Prem challenges to shut down her cafe.

videos.title: Digvijay Opens Up to Rahi
videos.overview: Digvijay confides in Rahi that he has come to fulfill Anupama's dream and stand by her. Vasundhara gifts a diamond necklace to Pari and urges Raj to put it on her.

videos.title: Rahi Chooses Prem
videos.overview: Prem asks Rahi to choose between him and Anupama, and she chooses Prem. Meanwhile, Digvijay and Anupama separately question Prerana and Ansh about their feelings.

videos.title: Prem Shares the News with Shruti
videos.overview: Anupama urges Ansh to confess to Prerana. Prem tells Shruti their café is selected for the Food Carnival festival and feels that Rahi has apologised to Anupama.

videos.title: Prem Takes a Stand for Rahi
videos.overview: Prem defends Rahi against Vasundhara's questioning and reassures her. Then he secretly hides from Rahi that he removed Anupama's café name from the form list.

videos.title: Anupama Reassures Rahi
videos.overview: The Shah family celebrates Hasmukh and Leela's anniversary. Anupama supports Rahi through personal challenges, fostering love and understanding.

videos.title: Ansh Confesses His Love
videos.overview: Anupama and Digvijay admire Hasmukh and Leela's enduring bond. Elsewhere, Ansh proposes to Prerana, while Ishani reveals her feelings to Banku.

videos.title: Digvijay's Plea to Banku
videos.overview: Digvijay asks Banku to leave after discovering his love for Ishani. A feverish Prem entrusts Rahi with his caféb presentation and other tasks.

videos.title: Anupama's Help Causes a Rift
videos.overview: As Rahi struggles with a crucial food order, Anupama steps in to help at Anuj's cafe. Soon after, Prem learns about it and fumes at Rahi, sparking a heated clash.

videos.title: Prem's Words Leave Rahi Heartbroken
videos.overview: An enraged Prem accuses Rahi of betrayal and tells her to leave the cafe with Anupama. Khyati comforts a heartbroken Rahi, while Anupama worries about her.

videos.title: Reunion of Rahi and Prem
videos.overview: Vasundhara convinces Prem that Anupama is driving a wedge between him and Rahi. After reuniting, Rahi promises never to leave Prem and admits she can't live without him.

videos.title: Ishani's Bold Confession
videos.overview: Tensions escalate in the Shah family as Leela refuses to accept Ansh and Prerana's wedding. The drama intensifies when Ishani confesses her love for Banku, enraging Pakhi.

videos.title: Rahi Reassures Ishani
videos.overview: Digvijay urges Banku to protect his relationship and be responsible. Rahi assures Ishani of his support and encourages her to reconsider before committing.

videos.title: Vasundhara's Request to Anupama
videos.overview: Vasundhara politely urges Anupama to stop Ishani from marrying Banku. Anupama suggests giving the couple a year to focus on their careers before reconsidering marriage.

videos.title: Anupama Is Up for the Competition
videos.overview: Ishani and Banku agree to take a year before reconsidering marriage, as Anupama suggested. Anupama is overjoyed when their café is selected for the competition.

videos.title: Ansh and Prerana's Eternal Vow
videos.overview: Digvijay gives his share of the profit to Anupama for Ansh and Prerana's wedding expenses. Ansh and Prerana pledge lifelong commitment and share a heartfelt moment.

videos.title: Anupama Wishes for a Dream Home
videos.overview: Anupama dreams of her self-owned house, cherishing the moment. Prem desperately urges Prerana to rethink marrying Ansh before it's too late.

videos.title: Prem's Unreasonable Demand
videos.overview: Anupama and Hasmukh visit the Kothari house to invite the family to Ansh and Prerana's wedding, but Prem refuses to attend. He agrees on a condition if Digvijay apologises to him.

videos.title: Digvijay's Shocking Apology to Prem
videos.overview: The Shah family gets emotional as Ansh and Prerana seek blessings from the late Samar. Elsewhere, Digvijay arrives at the Kothari house and apologises to Prem, shocking all.

videos.title: Ansh, Prerana Get Engaged
videos.overview: The Kotharis arrive at Ansh and Prerana's Gol Dhana ceremony. Ansh and Prerana seal their love with rings, while Paritosh stirs Gautam over Pranshi's custody.

videos.title: Prem Under Shruti's Pressure
videos.overview: Anupama is filled with joy seeing both families dance together, celebrating Ansh and Prerana. Shruti forces Prem to steal Anupama's secret recipe diary to win the competition.

videos.title: Prem Tries to Sabotage Anupama
videos.overview: As Anupama and Digvijay gear up for the first round of the cooking competition, Prem steals Anupama's recipe diary. Meanwhile, the competition begins with a unique challenge.

videos.title: Gautam Demands Pranshi Back
videos.overview: Anupama and Prem clear first round of the cooking competition. Fuming Gautam enters the Shah house demanding Pranshi, but Anupama confronts and exposes his lack of care for her.

videos.title: Shah Cousins Plan Bachelor Party
videos.overview: The Shah cousins gear up for a bachelor party, inviting Prem and Rahi to join, and wait for Leela's permission. Gautam receives a police warning for troubling the Shahs.

videos.title: Gautam Fights for Pranshi
videos.overview: Gautam fiercely claims Pranshi as his daughter, vowing no one will separate them. At the bachelor party, destiny unfolds as everyone opens their fortune chocolates.

videos.title: Gautam's Entry Sparks Chaos
videos.overview: Anupama prepares for Ansh, Prerana's mehendi, but is unaware that he has fallen into Gautam's trap during the party. Later, Gautam arrives uninvited and faces sharp criticism.

videos.title: Ansh Faces Accusations
videos.overview: Anupama and Prem demand Meeta apologise to Pari for publicly insulting her. The drama intensifies as a police officer arrives to arrest Ansh for molestation.

videos.title: Prerana Doubts Gautam
videos.overview: Prerana suspects Gautam orchestrated Ansh's arrest out of revenge. Anupama boldly vows to prove Ansh's innocence and confronts the woman behind the false accusation.

videos.title: Shruti's Plea to Prem
videos.overview: The family urgently calls every guest, determined to find proof of Ansh's innocence. Shruti requests Prem to prioritise his cafe over aiding the competition.

videos.title: Anupama Proves Ansh's Innocence
videos.overview: Anupama hands the video to the police, proving Ansh's innocence. Elsewhere, Gautam worries that his conspiracy against Ansh may get exposed.

videos.title: Pakhi Accuses Banku of Theft
videos.overview: The Shahs joyfully celebrate Ansh and Prerna's Haldi ceremony. The mood turns tense when Banku gifts Ishani a pair of earrings, and Pakhi accuses him of stealing money to buy them.

videos.title: Anupama Reassures Leela
videos.overview: Anupama and Ishani rebuke Pakhi for falsely framing Banku. Leela worries that Prerana is not the right match for Ansh, but Anupama assures her about their relationship.

videos.title: Prerana Misses Her Family
videos.overview: Prerana is heartbroken as her family says they can't attend her wedding. Hurt by Prerana's disrespect, Leela decides to leave the house, but the family convinces her to stay.

videos.title: Ansh, Prerana's Wedding Begins
videos.overview: Ansh's arrival with the wedding procession reminds Anupama of Samar, while Prerana makes a stunning bridal entry. Paritosh learns that Prem has Anupama's recipe diary.

videos.title: Paritosh Blackmails Prem
videos.overview: Paritosh extorts Prem, demanding money in exchange for keeping his diary theft a secret. As Anupama worries over her missing recipe diary, Ansh and Prerana tie the knot.

videos.title: Paritosh Exposes Prem's Big Theft
videos.overview: Anupama performs Prerana's Gruhapravesh with Ansh as part of their marriage rituals. Tensions rise as Paritosh reveals that Prem has stolen Anupama's recipe diary.

videos.title: Prem's Hatred Shatters Anupama
videos.overview: Vasundhara confronts Prem over his actions and warns Shruti to stay away from him. Meanwhile, Anupama pours out her heartbreak to Digvijay about Prem's hatred.

videos.title: Rahi Draws the Line
videos.overview: Anupama meets Prem and has an emotional confrontation over his hatred. Meanwhile, Rahi warns Shruti not to fuel Prem's hatred and asks her to stay away from him.

videos.title: Prem's Ultimatum to Rahi
videos.overview: Prem asks Rahi to leave the house, demanding that she choose between him and Anupama. Soon after, tensions escalate as Pari arrives at the Shah house in search of Rahi.

videos.title: Khyati Fumes at Prem
videos.overview: Khyati confronts Prem for letting his ego overshadow his love for Rahi. Overwhelmed with emotion, Rahi confides her grief to Anupama in a heartfelt moment.

videos.title: Vasundhara Fears for Rahi and Prem
videos.overview: Vasundhara worries about Rahi and Prem's relationship and shares it with Khyati. Soon, Anupama opens up to Leela about the joy and peace of having a home of her own.

videos.title: Anupama Builds Her Team
videos.overview: The competition begins as Anupama and Prem form their teams. While Paritosh and Pakhi choose Anupama, Prem is determined to have Khyati on his side.

videos.title: Rahi Stands by Khyati
videos.overview: Rahi defends Khyati's sacrifices for the family when Shruti criticises her. Elsewhere, Anupama tells Digvijay about her wish to live in her dream home.

videos.title: Anupama, Prem Lock Horns
videos.overview: Anupama aims to win the competition to build her house, while Prem is determined to defeat her. Soon after, the host introduces the teams participating in the competition.

videos.title: Will Prem Defeat Anupama?
videos.overview: Anupama and Prem's teams face the judges as the cooking competition begins. Later, every team races against time to prepare their assigned dish in the first round.

videos.title: Anupama Leads with Calmness
videos.overview: Anupama guides her team with confidence as the competition intensifies. Meanwhile, Prem's impressive dish raises the stakes as both teams battle for a place in the next round.

videos.title: Pari Stands Up for Rahi
videos.overview: Chaos erupts in the Shah family when Pakhi blames Prerana for the competition mishap. Prem is disappointed with Rahi and Shruti, but Pari steps in to defend Rahi.

videos.title: Shruti's Bold Decision
videos.overview: Prem announces to the team that he will lead them with arrogance. Shruti is determined to win the competition and take Prem and Rahi with her to the US.
